constructs.name: Initiative posture
constructs.definition: Preference to advance a plan first or preserve resources to answer others.
constructs.dependency_overlap: All C01 scenarios share DG_C01 and cannot stack. Initiative posture may vary by game context; systematic divergence requires later split or restriction before scoring authority.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Resource visibility
constructs.definition: Preference for power visible on the battlefield or held in hand, mana, or other less visible zones.
constructs.does_not_mean: Deception, control, fairness, or actual threat.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C08 and C11; visibility is not threat level.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Disruption response
constructs.definition: Preference to protect an established position, reduce exposure, or recover after broad disruption.
constructs.does_not_mean: Resilience, interaction density, or high power.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C05/C06; commander protection is not commander dependence.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Advantage tempo
constructs.definition: Preference for repeated small gains, cycles, or one concentrated payoff.
constructs.does_not_mean: Game length, ending mode, or power.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C14; setup length and payoff rhythm differ.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Commander reliance
constructs.definition: How much the deck should depend on its commander being available.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Separate from C03 protection and C06 engine concentration.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Engine concentration
constructs.definition: Preference for one central engine, replaceable pieces, or overlapping small engines.
constructs.does_not_mean: Consistency, tutoring, complexity, or commander reliance.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C05/C09; shares a dependency group.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Pressure channel
constructs.definition: Preferred way to move the game toward an ending.
constructs.does_not_mean: Power, morality, speed, or opponent enjoyment.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C04/C11; ending mode is not payoff rhythm or visibility.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Mana commitment and interaction window
constructs.definition: Preference to commit mana on one's own turn or retain options during opponents' turns.
constructs.does_not_mean: Personality, skill, interaction density, or Blue identity.
constructs.dependency_overlap: C01 and both C08 items share a cap when they describe one cadence.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Repeatability preference
constructs.definition: Preference for familiar access to a central plan or greater game-to-game variance.
constructs.does_not_mean: Tutor count, optimization, competence, or budget.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C06; repeatability is not engine centrality.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Theme-efficiency tradeoff
constructs.definition: Willingness to keep thematic expression when a more reliable role-player exists.
constructs.does_not_mean: Low power, inexperience, budget, or aesthetic color preference.
constructs.dependency_overlap: A secondary deckbuilding layer; never sufficient for identity.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Threat posture
constructs.definition: Preference to avoid early attention, adapt to attention, or embrace being the visible threat.
constructs.does_not_mean: Actual power, aggression, sociability, or willingness to win.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C02; visible resources and accepted attention differ.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Resource sacrifice
constructs.definition: Willingness to spend permanents, life, cards, or position as fuel for later advantage.
constructs.does_not_mean: Recklessness, Black identity, graveyard strategy, or risk tolerance.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Separate voluntary conversion from disruption losses.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Public commitment
constructs.definition: How much spoken table agreements should bind later choices.
constructs.does_not_mean: Honesty, morality, sociability, or political skill.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Table preference cannot independently place an identity.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Setup tolerance
constructs.definition: How long a deck may develop before meaningfully affecting the table.
constructs.does_not_mean: Desired game length, power, patience, or skill.
constructs.dependency_overlap: Overlaps C04; setup duration is not payoff concentration.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Deck breadth and constraint
constructs.definition: Preference for how much of the deckbuilding boundary should come from the available card pool versus restrictions the builder chooses within broader access.
constructs.does_not_mean: Colorless, Five-Color, theme, skill, complexity, budget, or power by itself.
constructs.dependency_overlap: A boundary observation only; imposed limits and self-chosen limits must remain distinct; overlaps C09/C10.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

constructs.name: Information-to-plan conversion
constructs.definition: After interaction or new card access creates several viable options, preference to consolidate one route, retain broad optionality, or exploit the current opening.
constructs.does_not_mean: Intelligence, optimization, control skill, threat-assessment skill, knowledge level, combo preference, archetype, motive, or Esper philosophy.
constructs.dependency_overlap: DG_C16 is independent of C01/C04/C06/C08/C09/C14/C15. C16 starts only after options exist: it records route commitment, not initiative, payoff rhythm, engine structure, interaction timing, cross-game repeatability, setup horizon, or deckbuilding breadth.
constructs.scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

answers.exclusions: Combat coordination does not establish Boros, Mardu, Dune, duty, or leadership.
answers.limitation: The tactically strongest attack may look coordinated without reflecting a stable preference.

answers.title: Use the bodies already there

answers.exclusions: Combat alone does not establish Red, Gruul, Jund, aggression, or experience level.
answers.limitation: Many decks attack when shields are down; independent motive and context remain necessary.

answers.title: Keep the wide board moving

answers.limitation: Many identities can use engines; the observation describes pressure channel only.
